/**
 * Design tokens from the Gradebook Ghana mockups (Nov 2026 redesign).
 *
 * The mockups derive buttons, the side rail, class-card bands and focus
 * rings from a single `--brand` colour. The per-school colour picker
 * from the first redesign pass was dropped (Nov 2026 follow-up): the
 * app uses the mockups' indigo everywhere.
 */export const DEFAULT_BRAND='#3647c9';/** WAEC band for a total, with the remark and chip colour from the mockups. */export function gradeBand(total){if(total>=90)return{letter:'A1',remark:'Excellent',bg:'#d4f0e2'};if(total>=80)return{letter:'B2',remark:'Very Good',bg:'#e0f0d4'};if(total>=70)return{letter:'B3',remark:'Good',bg:'#ecf3cf'};if(total>=60)return{letter:'C4',remark:'Credit',bg:'#f8efc6'};if(total>=55)return{letter:'C5',remark:'Credit',bg:'#f8efc6'};if(total>=50)return{letter:'C6',remark:'Credit',bg:'#f8efc6'};if(total>=45)return{letter:'D7',remark:'Pass',bg:'#fbe0c0'};if(total>=40)return{letter:'E8',remark:'Pass',bg:'#fbe0c0'};return{letter:'F9',remark:'Fail',bg:'#f8d2cd'};}/** Chip background for a grade letter (falls back via gradeBand thresholds). */export function gradeChipBg(letter){switch(letter){case'A1':return'#d4f0e2';case'B2':return'#e0f0d4';case'B3':return'#ecf3cf';case'C4':case'C5':case'C6':return'#f8efc6';case'D7':case'E8':return'#fbe0c0';case'F9':return'#f8d2cd';default:return'transparent';}}/**
 * Short class code shown on the coloured card bands in the mockups:
 * "1 Science 1" -> "1S1", "2 Arts 1" -> "2A1", "1 General Arts 3" -> "1GA3",
 * "3 Business 2" -> "3B2". Falls back to the initials of the name.
 */export function classCode(name){const parts=name.trim().split(/\s+/);if(parts.length>=3&&/^\d+$/.test(parts[0])&&/^\d+$/.test(parts[parts.length-1])){const middle=parts.slice(1,-1).map(w=>w.charAt(0).toUpperCase()).join('');return`${parts[0]}${middle}${parts[parts.length-1]}`;}return parts.map(w=>w.charAt(0).toUpperCase()).join('').slice(0,4);}/** Card band shades cycled in the mockups: full brand, 45%, 32%. */export const BAND_SHADES=[100,45,32];export function bandStyle(index){const shade=BAND_SHADES[index%BAND_SHADES.length];return{background:`color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand) ${shade}%, #fff)`,color:shade===100?'#fff':'#1d2347'};}/** A mark is valid when empty, or a whole number / one decimal from 0 to 100 (mockup rule). */export function isValidMark(v){return v===''||/^\d{1,3}(\.\d)?$/.test(v)&&Number(v)<=100;}
